notes.title: Casinopia Update Note (2017.10.24)
notes.content:
Greetings all,

Today we have an update for the game. We made some improvement and fixed a few bugs.

Update:
- Fixed a bug that caused MENU button stopped working.
- Fixed a bug where you could not close the Gold Shop window.
- Improvements on the game's ease of use/convenience.

Thank you! :)

notes.title: Controllers Manual Instruction
notes.content:
Please refer to the information below for the controllers instruction manual:

1. Application Menu Button: Game Menu

2. Trigger Button: By pressing trigger button you may pick chips to bet, hold down the trigger to grab chips. You can also choose the amount of money to bet by using touchpad.

3. Touchpad: Use touchpad to walk around when you are a spectator. Also you can use Right-Left touchpad to choose the amount of money for betting and to choose action while playing the game such as HIT, STAND, DOUBLE DOWN, and SURRENDER. (check image below)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760176/ebe96866c84581aae9628f58e8ee9e7991081b20.png

4. Motion Controller: activate motion controller by moving the controller up-down(HIT) or right-left(STAND). There will be 2 labels on the table, HIT and STAND. Please be aware that those labels are not buttons, moving your controllers towards those labels might cause unwanted motion control. (e.g. when a player tries to click HIT label with right hands, the game might take it as right-left motion which is STAND) 


ENJOY!!

notes.title: The latest version of graphics card is needed to play the game!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

If you encounter issues during the game, please update your graphics card to the latest version. 

Please follow the step below to update your graphics card:

1. Open  NVIDIA Website.
2. Click ‘Start Search’ on Manual Driver Search section.
3. The result will come up and click the latest version (check the latest release 4. date), and you will go to another page.
5. Click ‘Agree & Download’.
6. Install the file after completing the download.
7. Enjoy the game!! ^^

(see the image below for details)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760176/2eed88c1f87576e8ed399e05a63f75a60b2b1fde.png
